pain.headline:
You train.
But you don’t really know why.
pain.body: Scrolled feeds. Random tips. Workouts you copy without understanding.

amplify.headline: It’s not a lack of willpower.
amplify.body: It’s a system: without knowing what to target, you repeat effort — not progress.

positioning.headline: The problem isn’t doing more.
positioning.insight: It’s knowing exactly what to do — and why — while you rest.
positioning.solution: Muscle Mind gives you body science in 2-minute micro-lessons, between sets.

personalize.headline: What’s holding you back most?
personalize.hint: One answer is enough. We build your diagnosis from it.
personalize.emptyHint: One answer is enough to build your diagnosis.

preview.headline: Here’s how we’ll get you there
preview.body: You leave with a first win already. Depth continues behind it.

paywall.headline: Go all the way on your plan
paywall.sub: You’ve started. Genius removes the brakes so the science doesn’t stop between sets.
benefits: Rest timer built into your session

blockers.understand_training: I don’t know why I do an exercise
blockers.autonomy: I rely too much on a coach / TikTok
blockers.nutrition: I want to eat better to progress

understand_training.echo: You want to know why you do each exercise.
understand_training.diagnosis: Without the “why”, you copy programs. The stimulus misses — and you plateau without seeing it.
understand_training.firstStep: First lesson: understand what a muscle really does. 2 minutes, between sets.
understand_training.premiumHook: The full path links each exercise to its muscle, role, and progression.

progress.echo: You train — but results don’t follow.
progress.diagnosis: Plateaus often come from missing scientific structure, not missing willpower.
progress.firstStep: We start with body basics: without that, clean progress is impossible.
progress.premiumHook: Genius unlocks continuous follow-through so you’re never stuck between lessons.

anatomy.echo: You finally want to understand your body.
anatomy.diagnosis: Without a mental map of the body, every session stays fuzzy. You move — you don’t learn.
anatomy.firstStep: Anatomy micro-lesson: one puzzle piece, during a rest.
anatomy.premiumHook: The full Anatomy path gives you the complete map, theme after theme.

build_workouts.echo: You want sessions that actually hold up.
build_workouts.diagnosis: Stacking exercises by feel creates volume without logic. The body adapts poorly.
build_workouts.firstStep: We lay the anatomy base first: you’ll know what each movement targets.
build_workouts.premiumHook: Next: programming, volume, progression — the full plan behind the first lesson.

autonomy.echo: You want to decide without depending on a feed.
autonomy.diagnosis: Short tips tell you what to do, rarely why. You stay dependent.
autonomy.firstStep: One clear, sourced lesson — yours — during rest. Not a scroll.
autonomy.premiumHook: The path trains you to judge alone: real autonomy, not another coach in your pocket.

nutrition.echo: You want to eat to progress.
nutrition.diagnosis: Without nutrition basics, gym effort is wasted. Fuel matters as much as load.
nutrition.firstStep: First nutrition lesson: energy and needs, in 2 minutes.
nutrition.premiumHook: The full Nutrition path structures protein, timing, and your plate.
